5.text: little way off, and awaits her turn. In another tale, about the “Shaman with

6.text: Warts,” each wife has her own sleeping-place. During the meal, the host

7.text: exclaims from the sleeping-room, “Oho! I have a visitor. Prepare another

8.text: sleeping-room.” Somebody is busy outside, rings with the bracelets, rattles

9.text: with the necklace, knocks the poles, hurries. “Where will you sleep?” asks

10.text: the host. “Decide yourself,” says the visitor. “Sleep here. I will sleep in

11.text: the other place.” He goes out, enters the other sleeping-room. The visitor

12.text: hears great laughter, frolic, the ringing of bracelets, the rattle of necklaces.

13.text: He says, “They must be enjoying themselves.”²

14.text: The position of the several wives is different in different families. The

15.text: first wife is generally much older, and has had several children when the

16.text: young wife makes her first appearance in the family. In such cases the first

17.text: wife is the mistress, while the second is treated almost like a maid. The

18.text: first wife sits with the husband in the warm sleeping-room, while the second

19.text: works outside in the cold, prepares the food, and serves it. In one tale of

20.text: my new collection there is a detailed description of how the husband and

21.text: his first wife make the second wife carry the chamber-pot in and out, and

22.text: wash her hands in their urine. Sometimes the aged husband takes a second

23.text: young wife for the express purpose of giving a helper and maid to his wife,

24.text: who is getting old and cannot get through with the housework by herself.

25.text: Cases have occurred where the first wife insisted that the husband should

26.text: marry a young and able-bodied woman.

27.text: In other cases, where the husband has no children by his wife, he mar-

28.text: ries another woman in order to get progeny. The absence of children is

29.text: considered so great a misfortune, that a good woman, if childless, herself

30.text: insists that her husband take another wife, even as Sarah made Abraham

31.text: sleep with one of her maids, and made her be delivered of the child into
